text: Rob Bonta runs for California Attorney General. He has not publicly called the war in Gaza a genocide or backed blocking U.S. weapons transfers to Israel. What he has done: in September 2026, his office dismissed felony vandalism and conspiracy charges against five pro-Palestinian Stanford protesters, reducing their punishment to community service and restitution. CAIR Action endorsed him, Vote for Peace rated him an Ally, and Rep. Ro Khanna endorsed him. His platform commits to enforcing California's civil rights code, building bridges between law enforcement and targeted communities, and prosecuting transnational criminal organizations. By contrast, Michael Gates, as a DOJ official, co-authored a March 2025 letter opening a civil rights investigation into the University of California over alleged discrimination against Jewish or Israeli employees. Gates holds endorsements from The Israeli-American Civic Action Network and Americans4Hindus, while no pro-Palestine-aligned organization in this record backs him. Bonta's decision to reduce criminal exposure for pro-Palestinian protesters, his civil-liberties platform, and his backing from CAIR Action and Vote for Peace make him the stronger of the two documented candidates for this office.
